description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy/correlation values for three different metrics – Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy – across five models: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The horizontal axis represents the model names, listed in the order Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For each model, there are three bars representing the three metrics; the Sentiment Accuracy is represented by a blue bar, the STS Correlation by a light blue bar, and the Paraphrase Accuracy by a light red bar. For the Single-task_baseline model, the Sentiment Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.48, the STS Correlation bar reaches approximately 0.52, and the Paraphrase Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.64. For the 2-Tier SimCSE model, the Sentiment Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.76, the STS Correlation bar reaches approximately 0.78, and the Paraphrase Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.74. The bars are grouped by model, with each metric represented side-by-side within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
